limits: Trial M2/M2.5/M3 fastening and straight-shank access only, not actual threads or hands. P3 power populated fit and rear-interface components/final retention still pending.
additional_assembly: With pitch head and shells detached, bench-fit fixed reaction link/horn/clamp through the combined yaw U/journal. Insert this group into bearing/bridge, then fit reaction cross-retainer, yaw servo/output and lock. Removal reverses this sequence; reaction link travels with U/journal after cross-retainer removal. In operation the reaction link remains BODY-fixed, never yaw-parented. M1.14: install6 flange screws per motor on bench before bearings; slide bearings/spacers onto shaft; insert whole cartridges from below; fit common cap with4 M3 bolts; install load frame, shell, then D hubs and end washers/M3 screws. Release wheel end bolts before cap/cartridge removal.
